title.en: Check the RTMP port is reachable
title.hinglish: RTMP port reachable hai ya nahi check karo

why.en: RTMP rides on TCP port 1935. A public ingest host lets you see the TCP connection open before the C0/C1 handshake.
why.hinglish: RTMP TCP port 1935 par chalta hai. Public ingest host par aap C0/C1 handshake se pehle TCP connection khulte dekh sakte ho.

expect.en: Usually TcpTestSucceeded : True (or 'succeeded'), but it varies by network; some networks block 1935. This is only the TCP step, no RTMP data is sent.
expect.hinglish: Aam taur par TcpTestSucceeded : True (ya 'succeeded') aata hai, par ye network par depend karta hai; kuch networks 1935 block karte hain. Ye sirf TCP step hai, koi RTMP data nahi jaata.

title.en: Find the RTMP handshake in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter on the RTMP port to see the C0/C1, S0/S1/S2 and C2 blocks.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur RTMP port par filter lagao, C0/C1, S0/S1/S2 aur C2 blocks dikh jayenge.

expect.en: A TCP handshake, then the 1537-byte C0+C1 split over two segments, the 3073-byte server reply, then RTMP chunk messages.
expect.hinglish: Pehle TCP handshake, phir 1537-byte C0+C1 do segments mein split, 3073-byte server reply, aur uske baad RTMP chunk messages.

title.en: Spot the stream key in clear text
title.hinglish: Clear text mein stream key pakdo

why.en: Plain RTMP is unencrypted, so the publish command carries the key in the open. Filter RTMP messages and inspect the publish packet.
why.hinglish: Plain RTMP encrypted nahi hota, isliye publish command mein key khuli hoti hai. RTMP messages filter karo aur publish packet dekho.

expect.en: Packets decoded as RTMP; the publish packet shows the stream name (the key) as readable text. The bad-key scenario shows an onStatus with NetStream.Publish.BadName.
expect.hinglish: Packets RTMP ki tarah decode hote hain; publish packet mein stream name (key) padhne layak text mein dikhta hai. bad-key scenario mein onStatus aur NetStream.Publish.BadName dikhta hai.
